newsitem.title: USA: Birmingham Steel buys Atlantic assets.
newsitem.headline: Birmingham Steel buys Atlantic assets.

text.p: Birmingham Steel Corp said it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire certain assets of Atlantic Steel Industries Inc through a newly created company, Birmingham Southeast LLC.
Birmingham said it would own 85 percent of the new company and Ivaco Inc, a subsidiary of Atlantic's parent, the other 15 percent.
It said it expected to close the deal before the end of the year.
Under the deal, Birmingham Southeast would acquire Atlantic Steel assets at its plant in Cartersville, Georgia, and the Birmingham Steel assets at its mini-mill in Jackson, Mississippi, it said.
As part of the financing for this transaction, Birmingham Steel said it would re-issue 1.0 million common shares currently being held as Treasury shares.
"Completion of this transaction will increase our market share through the acquisition of quality steel producing assets in attractive markets," Birmingham Steel said.
